entries.title: Seed and sprout
entries.literal_meaning: As the seed, so the sprout.
entries.explanation: The repeated matching words make the beginning and its result answer one another. The dictionary explains ତେସା as “of that kind”; it supplies no social-use gloss. Our reading applies the image to work: what goes into a task can shape what comes out. This is a comparison to examine, not a guarantee of results or a judgment about inherited human worth.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯେମିତି ବୀଜ, ସେମିତି ଅଙ୍କୁର—ମେଳ ଖାଉଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ଓ ଫଳ ଯୋଡ଼ିହୁଏ। ଅଭିଧାନ ତେସାର ଅର୍ଥ ସେହି ପ୍ରକାରର ବୋଲି ଦିଏ; ବ୍ୟବହାରର ପୂରା ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଦିଏନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ କାମର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଯାହା ରଖୁ, ଫଳରେ ତାହାର ଚିହ୍ନ ରହିପାରେ। ଏହା ଫଳର ନିଶ୍ଚୟତା ବା ମଣିଷର ବଂଶଗତ ମୂଲ୍ୟର ରାୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading connects a task’s starting material with its result.
entries.odia_summary: କାମର ଆରମ୍ଭ ଓ ଫଳର ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଦେଖେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: A team copies an unchecked list into its new catalogue, then finds the same mistakes there. A colleague quotes the seed-and-sprout line and suggests checking the original list before copying it again. This application concerns a process, not anyone’s parentage.
entries.cultural_context: The headword is labelled adapted from Hindi; this does not establish the saying’s origin or route of borrowing. No caste, family or community trait is inferred.

entries.title: Adding to a hurt
entries.literal_meaning: Smear mustard paste on a cut wound.
entries.explanation: The short phrase puts a deliberate action against an existing hurt. The dictionary glosses ଛାପ୍ୱା as smearing and repeats the expression with ମଡ଼ାଇବା. Our figurative reading hears an added injury: a taunt or needless reproach when someone is already upset. The wound is the image carrying that reading, not a treatment instruction.
entries.meaning_odia: ଆଗରୁ କଟା ଘା ଅଛି, ତାହା ଉପରେ ପୁଣି ବେଶର ବୋଳାଯାଉଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଛାପ୍ୱାକୁ ବୋଳିବା ବା ମଡ଼ାଇବା ବୋଲି ବୁଝାଏ। ଆମ ରୂପକ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଆଗରୁ ଦୁଃଖିତ ଲୋକକୁ ଟାହି ବା ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ଭର୍ତ୍ସନାରେ ଆହୁରି କଷ୍ଟ ଦେବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଆସେ। ଏହି ଘାର ଚିତ୍ର କଥାର ଦଂଶନ ବୁଝାଏ, ଚିକିତ୍ସାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a further hurt added to one already felt.
entries.odia_summary: ଆଗରୁ ଥିବା କଷ୍ଟକୁ ଆହୁରି ବଢ଼ାଇବାର ଚିତ୍ର।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: A friend is disappointed after missing a deadline. When another person repeatedly jokes about the mistake, someone quotes this phrase and asks them to stop. The imagined use challenges the extra taunt without excusing the missed deadline.
entries.cultural_context: The source labels this Sambalpuri. Lexical220334 supplies Odia ସୋରଷବଟା; its English “rye paste” is retained as a source discrepancy, not adopted. That source is lexical context only. Social application is editorial.

entries.title: Drop after drop
entries.category: descriptive rhythmic formula; dictionary-labelled Dhaga, not a moral proverb
entries.explanation: The repeated ending lets the ear follow separate drops. Unlike a moral saying, this short formula describes an action through sound. The source explicitly glosses juice falling drop by drop. Our reading enjoys the playful rhythm without adding a lesson about people or claiming a particular performance tradition.
entries.meaning_odia: ଥପଂ ଥପଂର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତିରେ ଟୋପା ପରେ ଟୋପା ପଡ଼ିବାର ଲୟ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନ ମଧ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ଦ୍ରବ୍ୟରୁ ଟୋପା ଟୋପା ରସ ଗଳିବା ବୋଲି ବୁଝାଏ। ଏଠି ଶବ୍ଦର ଖେଳ ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ରିୟାକୁ ଶୁଣାଏ; ମଣିଷ ପାଇଁ ନୀତିବାକ୍ୟ ତିଆରି କରେନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଲୟର ରସଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
entries.english_summary: A descriptive sound-play formula follows juice falling drop by drop.
entries.odia_summary: ଟୋପା ଟୋପା ରସ ଗଳିବାକୁ ଶବ୍ଦର ଲୟ ଅନୁସରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: While squeezing a cut orange over a bowl, a reader watches the last drops fall and playfully says the line in time with them. The orange and this conversation are invented; the source names no particular fruit or occasion.
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary labels it Dhaga, but the supplied gloss is descriptive. Treat it as language play, not a popular standalone proverb or an attested moral.94315 remains a possible alias awaiting full comparison.
